drivers.name: intake
drivers.why: RFQs arrive as prose, PDFs and CSV BOMs; replies carry POs, declines, amendments and finance decisions.

drivers.name: pricing
drivers.why: Customers ask us for prices: judge each customer with evidence, run the model, email finance, then quote.

drivers.name: orders
drivers.why: A customer PO becomes an SO at the approved quoted price, with POs from the sourcing rule's suppliers.

drivers.name: billing
drivers.why: Invoices with CA tax or the two fiscal positions; 3-way match of supplier bills.

drivers.name: cash
drivers.why: Pays suppliers only to bank details on file; applies inbound ACH.

drivers.name: reconcile
drivers.why: Mechanical comparison of ledger, Odoo and bank.

review_points: Finance approves every price before it is quoted to a customer (by replying to the report email)
The controller approves every sales order and its purchase orders
Any broker-sourced part (not an authorized source)
Every supplier payment before it is sent
assumptions: Quote history is simulated (seed/redwood_history.py), labelled source=simulated
Drop folder and outbox substitute for Gmail
Suppliers are paid on bill approval
approvals_why: Benchmark mode: a stand-in controller (bench/controller.py) and a stand-in finance team (bench/finance.py, by email) answer from the answer key.
wake_why: Workflows run only when the forwarder (desk/forwarder.py) fires their WidgeX hook.
